title: S 级核心词 · 第 25 组
objectives: 认识并会读这 40 个高频词：点 🔊 音标听发音，跟读一遍
记住每个词的**中文意思**和**英文释义**，并用近义词、反义词把意思连成一片
在例句短文里认出这些词，体会它们在句子里的语气（褒、贬、中性）

items.zh: 教育，灌输思想，向…灌输（尤指某种信条），使接受（教条）
items.en: to teach someone to accept a set of beliefs without question

items.zh: 辱骂的，污辱性的，臭名昭著的，令人鄙视的
items.en: expressing scorn; deserving of disgrace

items.zh: 不知道的，不知情的，健忘的，遗忘的，没有意识到的
items.en: not aware of what is happening around one

items.zh: 证词，证言，声明，证据，证明
items.en: a formal statement given as evidence; proof

items.zh: v./n. （使）过量，（使）饮食过度，过剩，（使）厌腻
items.en: an excessive amount; to overfill

blocks.text: The cult sought to [[indoctrinate]] the young with [[opprobrious]] slogans; the [[oblivious]] members gave [[testimony]] that showed a [[surfeit]] of blind loyalty.

items.zh: 脾气不好的，爱争吵的，难相处的，易怒的，坏脾气的
items.en: bad-tempered and difficult to deal with

items.zh: 溃败，惨败，崩溃，大失败，彻底垮台
items.en: a sudden, complete failure or collapse

items.zh: n. 边缘，外围，（头发）刘海，（装饰用的）流苏；adj. 次要的，边缘的；vt. 加穗于
items.en: the outer edge; not part of the mainstream

items.zh: 识别，辨别，分辨，看出，觉察出，理解
items.en: to perceive or recognize with effort

items.zh: 挑剔的，极仔细的，追求完美的，难取悦的，一丝不苟的，过分讲究的
items.en: very attentive to detail and hard to please

blocks.text: The [[cantankerous]] host faced a [[debacle]] when guests from the [[fringe]] arrived; he could not [[discern]] which were friends, and the [[fastidious]] cook walked out.

gloss.fastidious: 挑剔的，极仔细的，追求完美的

items.zh: n. 相对平静时期，间隙，暂停；vt. 使镇静，使安心，使放松，使平静，哄（孩子）入睡
items.en: a temporary period of calm; to soothe or deceive into calm

items.zh: vi. 减少，衰退，缺少，（月亮）亏缺，减弱，衰弱；n. 衰退，（月）亏
items.en: to decrease gradually in strength or size

items.zh: 辛苦地获得，夺取，（用力）扭转，强行夺取，费力地获取
items.en: to pull away by force or effort

items.zh: 牵强的，不可信的，不自然的，难以置信的，离奇的
items.en: unlikely and hard to believe

items.zh: 爆料，揭示，揭露，透露，（令人惊讶的）发现，启示
items.en: the disclosing of something previously hidden

blocks.text: After a brief [[lull]], the storm began to [[wane]]; sailors had to [[wrest]] the helm back, and the [[far-fetched]] tale of a sea beast was the biggest [[revelation]] of the trip.

items.zh: 计策，手段，策略，花招，诡计
items.en: a clever maneuver to gain an advantage

items.zh: 真实的，非仿造的，可信的，真品的，真迹的，可靠的
items.en: real, not copied or fake

items.zh: 诽谤，辱骂，诋毁，中伤
items.en: to speak of someone in an abusively bad way

items.zh: 赞颂之词，赞美，颂词，称赞
items.en: a speech or writing of glowing praise

items.zh: 泄露（秘密），透露，暴露，（向别人）泄漏
items.en: to make known something private or secret

blocks.text: The reporter's [[ploy]] was to feign an [[authentic]] interest; she would [[vilify]] no one, but wrote an [[encomium]] to the clerk who agreed to [[divulge]] the facts.

items.zh: 抚慰，劝解，平息…的怒气，讨好，（用供品等）息怒
items.en: to win over or appease someone angry

items.zh: 不切实际的，空想的，（因想法不切实际而）堂吉诃德式的，唐吉诃德式的
items.en: idealistic in an impractical way

items.zh: 有偏见的，有倾向性的，不公正的，（尤指政治上）有意宣传的
items.en: promoting a particular, often controversial, point of view

items.zh: 深思熟虑的，缓慢而稳定的，经过计量的，有分寸的，（言辞）经过考虑的
items.en: careful and deliberate; restrained

items.zh: 全面的，百科全书式的，广博的，知识渊博的
items.en: covering a very wide range of knowledge

blocks.text: The envoy tried to [[propitiate]] the [[tendentious]] council with a [[measured]] speech; her [[quixotic]] plan was praised for its [[encyclopedic]] detail.

items.zh: 有关的，适当的，贴切的，密切相关的，中肯的
items.en: closely connected to the subject at hand

items.zh: 开端，开始，起初，创始，起点
items.en: the start of something

items.zh: （吃喝等）有节制的，节俭的，节制的，饮食有节的，克制的
items.en: sparing in eating or drinking; self-denying

items.zh: vi. 突然下降，骤降，垂直落下，暴跌；n. 铅锤，测锤
items.en: to fall or drop sharply

items.zh: 不可渗透的，不可穿透的，难以理解的，费解的，无法了解的
items.en: impossible to get through or understand

blocks.text: His point was [[germane]] to the debate's [[inception]]; the [[abstemious]] clerk saw profits [[plummet]] as the new tax code stayed [[impenetrable]].

gloss.impenetrable: 不可渗透的，不可穿透的

items.zh: 不可战胜的，无敌的，不可超越的，难以克服的
items.en: too strong to be defeated

items.zh: 稀疏的，稀少的，（头发）稀疏的，分散的，不稠密的，零星的
items.en: thinly scattered; not dense

items.zh: n. （尤指艺术上的）先锋派，前卫派；adj. 前卫的，先锋派的，前卫派的
items.en: new, experimental, ahead of its time; pioneers in the arts

items.zh: 正直，诚实，廉正，正派
items.en: strong moral principles; honesty

items.zh: adj. 严肃的，清醒的，没喝醉的，节制的，冷静的，朴素的；v. （使）严肃，（使）清醒
items.en: serious and sensible; not drunk

blocks.text: The [[invincible]] king ruled a [[sparse]] realm of fine [[avant-garde]] artists; his [[probity]] made him a [[sober]] judge.

gloss.invincible: 不可战胜的，不可超越的

items.zh: 平庸的，乏味的，（食物）难消化的，（文体）枯燥的，古板的
items.en: dull, formal, and old-fashioned

items.zh: 乐观的，确信的，充满希望的，（面色）红润的
items.en: cheerfully optimistic, especially in a difficult situation

items.zh: 宏伟壮丽的，庄严的，雄伟的，威严的，高贵的
items.en: grand and impressive

items.zh: 固执己见者，有偏见的人，顽固者，（尤指在宗教、种族上）偏执者
items.en: a person intolerantly attached to their own views

items.zh: 犹豫，（在两种情绪、观点间）变化，摇摆，（钟摆般）摆动，振荡
items.en: to swing back and forth; to waver

blocks.text: The [[stodgy]] banker stayed [[sanguine]] before the [[majestic]] hall; a [[bigot]] in the crowd made him [[oscillate]] between rage and calm.

gloss.bigot: 固执己见者，有偏见的人

questions.explain: divulge：泄露（秘密），透露，暴露，（向别人）泄漏（to make known something private or secret）。近义词：reveal, disclose。
oblivious：不知道的，不知情的，健忘的，遗忘的，没有意识到的（not aware of what is happening around one）。近义词：unaware, heedless。

questions.q: 哪个词的意思是「乐观的，确信的」？
questions.explain: sanguine：乐观的，确信的，充满希望的，（面色）红润的（cheerfully optimistic, especially in a difficult situation）。

questions.q: 哪个词和 **slander** 的意思最接近？
questions.explain: vilify 与 slander 近义：to speak of someone in an abusively bad way。

questions.q:
选最适合填入空格的词：

> His point was germane to the debate's inception; the abstemious clerk saw profits ____ as the new tax code stayed impenetrable.
questions.explain: plummet：vi. 突然下降，骤降，垂直落下，暴跌；n. 铅锤，测锤（to fall or drop sharply）。
